label: Customer logo strip
purpose: Shows the customer firms that build on the platform as a row/grid of third-party logos.

changes: logo grid is 2 columns below md and 3 columns from md (grid-cols-[repeat(2,...)] md:grid-cols-[repeat(3,...)]); from lg the logos render as a single justified row (lines 315-339)
responsive.note: desktop 1440 height is that of the lg+ variant (lines 315-339): metrics line 20px, logo row 32px; the stacked variant is 0px (display: none) at that width

retrieval.summary: Grid of six real customer logos (third-party trademarks, never generated).

protectedContent.rule: Logos are third-party trademarks. Every image must be an explicit placeholder or a supplied real file (source: placeholder|supplied); a generator may not draw, recolour or invent a company's logo.
